notes: INSIDE half of the Artemis Mk1: the missile cradle with a feed chute on the right (the ammo rack sits beside it), power coupling, repair hatch and a lamp strip. charge: a missile slides in from the chute into the cradle (frame 5 = seated and ready, strip green); fire: the cradle is empty and the strip discharges. damaged: chute cracked, lamps dead, sparks; disabled: the missile is jammed half way in the chute. Barrel layer artemis_mk1_barrel: the twin-rail launcher head with one missile on the upper rail; fire: the missile leaves under power, then smoke.
